spans.s: इत्थ इत्थ, अम्, n. in astronomy = ἰχθύς

इत्था इत्था, ind., Ved. thus; (often used
in the Ṛg-veda, and sometimes only to lay stress on
a following word; therefore by native etymologists
[]
considered as a particle of affirmation.) इत्था is
often connected with words expressing devotion to
the gods &c. in the sense of thus, truly, really;
especially with धी as an adjective. Hence इत्था-
धी = such, i. e. true (सत्या) or real worship. Simi-
larly, इत्था-धी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, so devout, so pious, i. e.
very devout; (Sāy.) performing such or true works.

इत्थम् इत्थम्, ind. (fr. इद्, q. v.), thus, in
this manner; [cf. Lat. item.]
—इत्थं-विध, अस्,
आ, अम्, of such a kind, endowed with such qualities.
—इत्थङ्-कारम्, ind. in this manner.
—इत्थम्-
भाव, अस्, m. the being thus endowed.
—इत्थम्-
भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become thus, being thus or in
such manner; so circumstanced.

इत्थशाल इत्थशाल, (in astrology) N. of the
third Yoga, = Arabic إِتِّصال

इत्थात् इत्थात्, ind. (= इत्थम्), Ved. thus,
in this way.
